goal_text: A train leaves Station A at 8:00 AM heading toward Station B (200 miles away) at 60 mph. A second train leaves Station B at 8:30 AM heading toward Station A at 75 mph. At what clock time and at what distance from Station A do the trains meet?
ground_truth: At 8:30 AM, Train 1 has traveled 30 miles (head start). Remaining distance: 170 miles. Combined closing speed: 135 mph. Time to close: 170/135 = 1.259 hours = 75.5 minutes. Meeting time: 8:30 + 1:15.5 = 9:45-9:46 AM. Distance from A: 30 + 60*1.259 = 105.5 miles.
